t.zh: 農業養工業，然後出口
t.en: Farming funds industry, then exports

t.zh: 重化工業、十大建設與電子起步
t.en: Heavy industry, the Ten Projects and the start of electronics

t.zh: 科學園區擴張與全球分工
t.en: Science parks expand; global division of labour

t.zh: 產業創新條例與半導體成為主幹
t.en: The innovation statute; semiconductors become the trunk

t.zh: AI 伺服器、關稅與海外設廠
t.en: AI servers, tariffs and fabs abroad

t.zh: 政府開始編中期經濟建設計畫
t.en: The government begins drawing up medium-term economic plans

f.zh: 行政院的資料：從 1953 年起推動中期國家建設計畫，到 2016 年一共 16 期。
f.en: According to the Executive Yuan, medium-term national development plans have been drawn up since 1953, sixteen of them by 2016.

t.zh: 《獎勵投資條例》公布
t.en: Statute for the Encouragement of Investment promulgated

f.zh: 用租稅減免獎勵投資的專法，施行期間到 1990 年 12 月 31 日。
f.en: A statute rewarding investment with tax relief; it remained in force until 31 December 1990.

t.zh: 臺灣證券交易所開業
t.en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange opens

f.zh: 1961 年 10 月 23 日成立，隔年 2 月 9 日正式開業。
f.en: Founded on 23 October 1961, it opened for business on 9 February the following year.

t.zh: 高雄加工出口區設立
t.en: Kaohsiung Export Processing Zone established

f.zh: 臺灣第一個加工出口區。2021 年 3 月更名為科技產業園區。
f.en: Taiwan’s first export processing zone. It was renamed a Technology Industrial Park in March 2021.

t.zh: 工業技術研究院成立
t.en: Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) founded

f.zh: 同年 1 月立法院三讀通過設置條例。後來的積體電路技術移轉由它承接。
f.en: The legislature passed its founding statute in January of the same year. ITRI later carried out the integrated-circuit technology transfer.

t.zh: 十大建設開始
t.en: The Ten Major Construction Projects begin

f.zh: 原先是九項建設，加入核能發電廠後成為十大建設。各項完工年不同，北迴鐵路 1980 年 2 月全線完工。
f.en: Originally nine projects; a nuclear power plant made it ten. Completion dates differ, the North-Link railway was finished in February 1980.

t.zh: 工研院與美國 RCA 簽積體電路技術移轉合約
t.en: ITRI signs an integrated-circuit technology-transfer agreement with RCA

f.zh: 日期出自潘文淵博士的生平年表。
f.en: The date comes from the official chronology of Dr Pan Wen-yuan’s life.

t.zh: 《科學工業園區設置管理條例》公布
t.en: Act for the Establishment and Administration of Science Industrial Parks promulgated

f.zh: 科學園區的法源。2018 年更名為《科學園區設置管理條例》。
f.en: The legal basis for science parks. It was renamed in 2018.

t.zh: 聯華電子成立
t.en: United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) founded

f.zh: 日期是證交所公司基本資料登記的成立日。1985 年 7 月 16 日上市。
f.en: The date is the incorporation date in the TWSE company profile. It listed on 16 July 1985.

t.zh: 新竹科學工業園區成立
t.en: Hsinchu Science Industrial Park established

f.zh: 第一個科學園區。
f.en: The first science park.

t.zh: 貿易順差擴大，新臺幣升值
t.en: The trade surplus widens and the New Taiwan dollar appreciates

f.zh: 商品貿易順差 1984 年 85.9 億美元，1986 年 157.4 億美元。年底匯率 1985 年是 39.85 元兌 1 美元，1987 年是 28.55 元（經建會統計）。
f.en: The merchandise trade surplus was US$8.59 billion in 1984 and US$15.74 billion in 1986. The year-end exchange rate went from NT$39.85 to the US dollar in 1985 to NT$28.55 in 1987 (CEPD statistics).

t.zh: 台灣積體電路製造公司設立
t.en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) incorporated

f.zh: 1994 年 9 月 5 日上市。
f.en: It listed on 5 September 1994.

t.zh: 《促進產業升級條例》公布
t.en: Statute for Upgrading Industries promulgated

f.zh: 1991 年 1 月 1 日施行。租稅減免一章施行到 2009 年底。
f.en: In force from 1 January 1991. Its tax-relief chapter ran until the end of 2009.

t.zh: 證券櫃檯買賣中心設立
t.en: The Taipei Exchange (TPEx) established

f.zh: 接辦櫃檯買賣市場，也就是後來的上櫃與興櫃。
f.en: It took over the over-the-counter market, today’s TPEx mainboard and Emerging Stock Board.

t.zh: 南部科學工業園區籌設計畫核定
t.en: Plan for the Southern Taiwan Science Park approved

f.zh: 同年 2 月行政院決議設置。
f.en: The Executive Yuan had resolved to set it up in February of that year.

t.zh: 臺灣成為世界貿易組織第 144 個會員
t.en: Taiwan becomes the 144th member of the World Trade Organization

f.zh: 2001 年 11 月 12 日簽署入會議定書。
f.en: The accession protocol was signed on 12 November 2001.

t.zh: 中部科學工業園區籌設計畫核定
t.en: Plan for the Central Taiwan Science Park approved

f.zh: 2003 年 7 月 28 日開放廠商進駐。
f.en: It opened to tenants on 28 July 2003.

t.zh: 《產業創新條例》公布
t.en: Statute for Industrial Innovation promulgated

f.zh: 同一天公布廢止《促進產業升級條例》。現行的研發投資抵減都在這部法裡。
f.en: The Statute for Upgrading Industries was repealed the same day. Today’s R&D tax credits sit in this law.

t.zh: 海峽兩岸經濟合作架構協議（ECFA）簽署
t.en: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) signed

f.zh: 由海基會與海協會簽署，同年 9 月 12 日生效。
f.en: Signed by the Straits Exchange Foundation and its counterpart; it took effect on 12 September that year.

t.zh: 「5+2 產業創新」
t.en: The “5+2” industrial innovation programme

f.zh: 行政院長 2016 年 11 月表示，團隊 5 月上任以來推動這個方案，包括智慧機械、綠能科技、亞洲矽谷、生技醫藥、國防科技與新農業。
f.en: The premier said in November 2016 that his team had pursued it since taking office in May; it covered smart machinery, green energy, the “Asia Silicon Valley”, biomedicine, defence and new agriculture.

t.zh: 「歡迎台商回台投資行動方案」啟動
t.en: Action plan welcoming overseas Taiwanese businesses back to invest begins

f.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 5 日，372 家通過審核，預估投資約 1 兆 6,975 億元。這是通過審核的金額，不是實際到位數。
f.en: As of 5 November 2026, 372 companies had been approved, with estimated investment of about NT$1.70 trillion, the approved amount, not money actually spent.

t.zh: 台積電宣布到美國亞利桑那設廠
t.en: TSMC announces a fab in Arizona

f.zh: 當時公布 2021 到 2029 年總支出約 120 億美元。
f.en: Total spending from 2021 to 2029 was put at about US$12 billion at the time.

t.zh: 「六大核心戰略產業推動方案」
t.en: Programme for the Six Core Strategic Industries

f.zh: 國發會在行政院院會報告整體規劃。
f.en: The National Development Council presented the overall plan to the Executive Yuan Council.

t.zh: 台積電董事會核准在日本設子公司
t.en: TSMC’s board approves a subsidiary in Japan

f.zh: 熊本廠 2024 年 2 月 24 日舉行開幕典禮。
f.en: The Kumamoto fab held its opening ceremony on 24 February 2024.

t.zh: 美國《晶片與科學法》
t.en: The US CHIPS and Science Act

f.en: Public Law 117-167.

t.zh: 《產業創新條例》增訂第 10 條之 2
t.en: Article 10-2 added to the Statute for Industrial Innovation

f.zh: 前瞻創新研發支出的 25% 可以抵減營利事業所得稅，適用到 2029 年底。
f.en: 25% of spending on forward-looking innovative R&D can be credited against corporate income tax, through the end of 2029.

t.zh: 加權指數首次收在 20,000 點以上
t.en: The TAIEX closes above 20,000 for the first time

f.zh: 依證交所歷史指數資料逐日比對。
f.en: Determined by checking the exchange’s historical index data day by day.

t.zh: 台積電亞利桑那規劃加到超過 650 億美元
t.en: TSMC’s Arizona plan rises above US$65 billion

f.zh: 宣布興建第三座晶圓廠。
f.en: A third fab was announced.

t.zh: 台積電宣布在美國的總投資預期達 1,650 億美元
t.en: TSMC says its total US investment is expected to reach US$165 billion

f.zh: 在原有規劃上再加 1,000 億美元。
f.en: A further US$100 billion on top of the existing plan.

t.zh: 美國啟動半導體 232 條款調查
t.en: The United States opens a Section 232 investigation into semiconductors

f.zh: 2026 年 1 月 14 日公告第一階段：特定先進運算晶片課 25%。範圍更大的第二階段，截至 2026 年 11 月沒有查到官方公告。
f.en: Phase one was proclaimed on 14 January 2026: 25% on certain advanced computing chips. As of November 2026 no official announcement of a broader second phase could be found.

t.zh: 美國公布對等關稅，對臺稅率 32%
t.en: The United States announces reciprocal tariffs; Taiwan’s rate is 32%

f.zh: 行政院經貿談判辦公室的說明：同年 8 月降到 20%。
f.en: According to the Executive Yuan’s Office of Trade Negotiations, it was cut to 20% in August that year.

t.zh: 輝達在 Computex 公布臺灣新辦公室「Constellation」
t.en: NVIDIA unveils “Constellation”, its new Taiwan office, at Computex

t.zh: 加權指數首次收在 30,000 點以上
t.en: The TAIEX closes above 30,000 for the first time

f.zh: 依證交所歷史指數資料逐日比對。
f.en: Determined by checking the exchange’s historical index data day by day.

t.zh: 臺北市與輝達完成北士科地上權簽約
t.en: Taipei City and NVIDIA sign the land-rights contract at the Beitou-Shilin Technology Park

f.zh: 市府新聞稿：權利金 122 億元，輝達的投資營運計畫總額超過 400 億元。
f.en: City release: royalties of NT$12.2 billion; NVIDIA’s investment and operating plan totals more than NT$40 billion.

t.zh: 臺美簽署對等貿易協定
t.en: Taiwan and the United States sign an Agreement on Reciprocal Trade

f.zh: 行政院的說明：對等關稅 15% 且不疊加，2,072 項輸美產品豁免。簽署不等於生效，截至 2026 年 11 月沒有查到生效公告。
f.en: According to the Executive Yuan: a reciprocal tariff of 15% without stacking, and 2,072 export items exempted. Signing is not entry into force; as of November 2026 no notice of entry into force could be found.

t.zh: 美國最高法院裁定對等關稅的法律依據不成立
t.en: The US Supreme Court rules the legal basis for the reciprocal tariffs invalid

f.zh: 行政院的說明：美方改引貿易法第 122 條課 150 天的暫時性關稅；7 月 24 日公布的 301 調查新稅率，臺灣是 10% 且不疊加。
f.en: According to the Executive Yuan, Washington switched to a 150-day temporary tariff under Section 122 of the Trade Act; under the Section 301 rates announced on 24 July, Taiwan’s is 10% without stacking.

t.zh: 加權指數首次收在 40,000 點以上
t.en: The TAIEX closes above 40,000 for the first time

f.zh: 依證交所歷史指數資料逐日比對。
f.en: Determined by checking the exchange’s historical index data day by day.
